content: <thought>To obtain the precursors, I will apply retrosynthetic template 74054 to the product SMILES derived from the mapped reaction. The product SMILES (without atom‑mapping) is `O=C1CH2C2(CH2CH2CH2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])c21`. Using the apply_template tool with this SMILES and the template ID will return all possible precursor combinations.
